label: prop:colour-relabel-singlet
title: Swapping two colours preserves the quantum singlet only at q squared equal to one
html: Let K be a field and q \in K^\times. Let \varepsilon_q \in (K^3)^{\otimes 3} be the quantum colour singlet of Jimbo's braiding on K^3, normalised by \varepsilon_q(0,1,2) = 1. Let s be the permutation of the colour labels exchanging 0 and 1, and let (s\cdot w)(a,b,c) = w(s(a), s(b), s(c)). Then s \cdot \varepsilon_q is a scalar multiple of \varepsilon_q if and only if q^2 = 1. When q^2 = 1 the scalar is -q^{-1}.
heading: Proposition
